title: Understanding Popper
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of understanding popper and when it is appropriate.
Apply popper's purpose using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.
Check positioned dropdowns, tooltips, and popovers and identify one likely failure mode.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study understanding popper and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding Popper depends on clear plugin initialization and DOM ownership. Load Bootstrap JavaScript once, use supported data attributes or API methods consistently, and test for duplicate listeners or conflicting state updates.

content_blocks.title: Positioned overlay geometry
content_blocks.alt_text: An overlay positioning diagram labels the anchor, chosen tooltip placement, available viewport space, and collision-aware adjustment.
content_blocks.caption: Illustrate how Popper measures an anchor and chooses a placement that fits the viewport.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Understanding Popper depends on clear plugin initialization and DOM ownership. Load Bootstrap JavaScript once, use supported data attributes or API methods consistently, and test for duplicate listeners or conflicting state updates.

content_blocks.code:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Bootstrap lesson example</title>
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body>
  <main class="container py-4">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-toggle="tooltip" data-bs-title="Positioned relative to this control">Tooltip anchor</button>
  </main>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
  <script>document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]').forEach(el => new bootstrap.Tooltip(el));</script>
</body>
</html>

content_blocks.title: Version and implementation note
content_blocks.text: Tooltips and popovers require JavaScript initialization and Popper positioning. The Bootstrap bundle includes Popper; initialize dynamically inserted elements deliberately.
